messages:
marta_fin: Reconciliation picked up 11 invoices with proration lines equal to 0 after last night's pricing experiment rollout. NetSuite shows merged lines for plan-change events; Stripe shows normal pro-rated amounts. Anyone on the sequencing connector?

luis_eng: digging in relay logs. there was a ~90s sequencer token gap around 23:59 UTC when the connector swapped leader for an autoscale bump. older events with lower seq ids were processed after newer ones on replay. NS merge logic uses monotonic seq numbers and collapsed the earlier proration into the later invoice, resulting in a zeroed line.

sam_ops: deploy-bot shows an autoscale event at 23:58:41 UTC then a connector restart at 23:59:12. healthcheck passed but the in-flight replay used batch reordering. we also saw two retries back-to-back due to a temporary downstream 503.

anya_coll: impact: 11 customers impacted, est $2,250 of under-invoiced proration. collections has already emailed three customers about balance mismatches. finance needs a CSV (stripe_invoice, ns_invoice, customer_email, amount_delta) and approval to apply corrective invoices/adjustments.

luis_eng: quick mitigation: paused autoscale on the connector group and enabled strict-sequencer pinning to keep a single leader while we patch. also enabled per-event idempotency checks using stripe.event.id to prevent double-apply on replay.

marta_fin: good. please drop CSV to /shared/finance/sequencer-incidents/2305550000-proration-gap.csv and include a note field with "sequencer-reorder" and link to any support ticket. request ops approval for up to $2.5k in corrective invoices.

sam_ops: approved for up to $2.5k to expedite customer fixes. include audit tags: sequencer-replay-2305550000 and cc finance-ops. :white_check_mark:

luis_eng: root cause plan: 1) leader handoff race when autoscale restart occurred 2) batch retry replays didn't consult event.id dedupe 3) NS merge uses strict sequence ordering and merges proration lines when it sees seq inversion. fix plan: implement leader sticky lease for connectors, change retry to per-event, and add explicit ns merge-safeguard that preserves proration as separate line when event.id differs.

anya_coll: finance asks for a dry-run backfill first. please run backfill in dry-run mode to produce a staging table of proposed adjustments and attach to the CSV so we can sign off before apply.

luis_eng: will run dry-run now. sample event shape we used to validate merging logic:

{"id": "evt_pr_abc123", "type": "invoice.updated", "data": {"object": {"id": "in_1XyZ", "lines": [{"id": "il_1","amount": 500},{"id":"pr_1","amount": 50}] } }, "created": 1710000000}

luis_eng: dry-run complete: found 11 candidates. writing staging file and CSV to /shared/finance/sequencer-incidents/2305550000-proration-gap.csv. will tag ticket and ping when staging table is ready for finance review. keep responses short here.

marta_fin: received. finance will review staging and reply with apply or questions. thanks.
